title: Verint Unleashes Agentic AI: The Smart Evolution of Contact Centers Begins
summary: Verint has launched a suite of three new Agentic AI tools designed to revolutionize contact centers, moving artificial intelligence from experimental pilots into practical, production-ready applications. These capabilities aim to seamlessly orchestrate work between human and AI agents, enhancing efficiency, improving customer outcomes, and refining agent performance.
content:
The era of artificial intelligence in customer service is rapidly evolving beyond simple chatbots and into a sophisticated partnership with human agents. Verint is at the forefront of this shift, having just unveiled a powerful trio of Agentic AI capabilities poised to transform how contact centers operate.

Moving firmly past the pilot phase, these new tools — Workforce Intelligence, Desktop Intelligence, and Quality Intelligence — aren't just about automation; they're about orchestration. Verint's vision, embodied by its Agent Factory platform, is to create a harmonious ecosystem where human and AI agents collaborate, each playing to their strengths to deliver superior customer experiences and measurable results.

Workforce Intelligence is designed to fine-tune agent behavior and optimize scheduling, ensuring the right support is available at the right time. Desktop Intelligence streamlines workflows, providing agents with instantaneous access to critical information and automating routine tasks, freeing them to focus on complex customer needs. Meanwhile, Quality Intelligence elevates performance by continuously monitoring and measuring outcomes, ensuring consistent service quality and identifying areas for improvement.

What makes Verint's approach particularly compelling is the emphasis on “agentic” AI. This isn't just AI *doing* tasks; it’s AI *acting* intelligently and autonomously within defined parameters, often in concert with human oversight. This symbiotic relationship promises not only heightened efficiency but also a better working environment for human agents, empowering them with intelligent assistants that handle the grunt work and provide insights. The ultimate goal is a more unified, efficient, and customer-centric service operation, demonstrating that the future of customer interaction is undeniably collaborative.
keyTakeaways: Verint's new Agentic AI tools signify a major shift in customer service, moving AI from experimentation to core operational use in contact centers.
The suite, including Workforce, Desktop, and Quality Intelligence, aims to unify and optimize agent behavior, process efficiency, and and outcome measurement.
These tools are designed to facilitate intelligent collaboration between human and AI agents, enhancing overall service delivery and the agent experience.
